verdicts.reason: A: the 'SUNSET SALE' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy and the fine print, so it reads in the wrong order. The large circle is stretched into a flat ellipse that dominates the bottom half, and there is an awkward dead gap between the eyebrow and the CTA. The two-column split (product left, copy right) still suits the square and gives everything room to breathe. B: same reading-order fault, but 'SUNSET SALE' is also jammed against the CTA. The text block is stacked so tightly that the headline, body, fine print, eyebrow and button nearly touch. The body copy runs as one long line almost edge to edge, the logo is shrunk into a tiny badge stuck on a circle in the bottom-left corner, and the ellipse is distorted here too. That makes B more cramped and less faithful to the brand than A.
